cues: A data incident starts with a symptom, not a trusted action plan.
LedgerLens makes every transition inspectable: evidence, policy, authorization, receipts, and handoff.
This is the live public LedgerLens Space.
The banner matters: the hosted experience is a deterministic fixture replay, not a live provider run.
External mutations are off, fixture receipts stay visibly fixture-prefixed, candidateOnly is true, and canClaimAGI is false.
DataHub is the operating context.
LedgerLens grounds the recorded entity, owner, tier, runbook pointers, and downstream lineage before proposing work.
Lineage is metadata-derived, not causal proof, so root cause, impact, and recovery remain explicit unknowns.
The planner proposes reversible, allowlisted collaboration actions and binds them to an exact plan fingerprint.
Model variants provide advisory votes, but they cannot expand targets or authorize themselves.
The deterministic gate checks quorum, confidence, evidence identifiers, action types, parameters, risk, and the exact plan hash.
Replay execution shows the full state transition without disguising simulation as production.
GitHub, Slack, PagerDuty, and Jira cards retain fixture identifiers.
The replay records a fixture write-back and a next-agent memory package of known facts, unknowns, provenance, and next checks.
Now the evidence class changes to real, bounded execution.

In one authorized run, the deterministic gate approved the exact plan and the adapters executed one bounded action against all four providers: a GitHub issue, a Slack message, a PagerDuty event, and a Jira issue.
Each is one rehearsal action. It proves the adapter path, not sustained operation, incident causality, or recovery.
A separate live DataHub OSS receipt records the allowlisted save_document mutation.
DataHub returned a document URN, and the official MCP get_entities path retrieved that URN for the next agent.
This proves catalog persistence, not incident recovery.
The AI verification receipt is also separate.
A live planner and two configured verifier variants approved the bounded plan, while deterministic policy remained the authorization authority.
Distinct variants are recorded, but provider-family independence is not claimed.
The context ablation is now run through the real policy gate, not a scripted responder.
With catalog context the gate authorizes every scenario; without it, it refuses every scenario with its own reason codes.
That proves the fail-closed gate. It is offline, deterministic, and not external validation or proven model uplift.
LedgerLens: real receipts where real work occurred, visible fixtures everywhere else.
Candidate only. No AGI claim.
